freshResearch.officialViewerInspection: Requested the current official Shaoxing data map and Zhejiang geographic-information platform pages over HTTPS and inspected their JavaScript/configuration. The Shaoxing map bundle points to a Tianditu/general search and route service; the Zhejiang platform describes vector-tile/general geographic-information services. No public cadastral layer, safe parcel identity field, CRS/schema response, or bounded parcel geometry endpoint was exposed. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder field was used.

registryBasis: First-party official Shengzhou government/hosted material identifies the Shengzhou Real Estate Registration Service Center as responsible for citywide natural-resource and real-estate registration information collection, sharing, and cadastral investigation/registration work; official Shengzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material confirms the local bureau. This establishes a local registry custodian, not open parcel-vector access.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous request returned a safe native parcel identity and full polygon geometry. The exact WUP point was not shifted, and lack of a public parcel endpoint is not treated as citywide absence.

technicalBlocker: The inspected official public map applications expose general basemap, geocoding/search, route, and geographic-information platform functions but no anonymous cadastral parcel layer/API with safe ID, CRS, schema, and geometry response. A local registration system may exist behind a separate procedure or authentication boundary.
remainingUncertainty: Exact-point parcel coverage, current cadastral service URL, CRS/schema, native parcel ID field, and citywide completeness remain unknown. No absence inference is made from the map extent or endpoint discovery failure.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may independently qualify a first-party Shengzhou parcel adapter only after confirming a current public route, CRS/schema, safe native ID, and bounded geometry response.
